title: File Path in a File Viewer
description: A file viewer whose lightened $cover bar holds a monospaced trail in a TextFrame, with $truncate on each folder's BreadcrumbLabel, above the source of the file in another TextFrame, so the path lines up with the source. An icon CopyButton beside the landmark copies the whole path and reports success or failure with its icon, its tooltip, and its accessible name. Use it in a repository or file browser, and use the baseline trail for pages that aren't files.
